const s     = $input.first().json;
const g     = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
const state = g.reflection_state || {};

return [{ json: {
  final_answer:           s.current_draft,
  iterations_run:         s.current_iteration,
  termination_reason:     s.termination_reason,
  is_approved:            s.is_approved,
  final_critic_score:     s.critic_score,
  final_critic_feedback:  s.critic_feedback,
  final_dimension_scores: s.critic_dimension_scores,
  cap_reached:            s.cap_reached,
  min_iterations:         s.min_iterations,
  complexity:             s.complexity,
  input_text:             s.input_text,
  start_time_ms:          s.start_time_ms,
  input_token_estimate:   s.input_token_estimate,
  max_iterations:         s.max_iterations,
  iterations_log:         state.iterations_log   || [],
  total_gen_tokens:       state.total_gen_tokens  || 0,
  total_crit_tokens:      state.total_crit_tokens || 0
} }];
